headline: 5 in-scope V2 contract types identified from audit scope; zero deployed addresses recovered this run — contract-addresses doc page and GitHub unreachable.

findings.text: D1: Etherscan name-tag search for 'Axis' / 'USDx' / 'Coordinate Labs' returned no addresses attributable to axis.to. Multiple unrelated protocols (AxisDeFi, USDX Dollar Protocol, LineAxis) appeared; none match Coordinate Labs Pte. Ltd. No Axis V2 addresses surfaced from block-explorer search.

D2: The official deployed-contracts page is referenced in docs at https://docs.axis.to/reference/contract-addresses but that URL was rejected by the fetch allowlist (not previously fetched). The docs/audits page confirms a contract-addresses reference exists. deployed_contracts_doc set to that URL pending a future fetch.

D3: OpenZeppelin V2 audit (July 2026, commit 6db59ec) walked and parsed. In-scope contracts: USDx (ERC-20 stablecoin with pause/blacklist/bridge), USDxMarket (primary settlement market), MarketConfig (routing/capacity config), StakedUSDx (ERC-4626/ERC-7540 staking vault), AxisV2Ids (library, not upgradeable). All four contracts are upgradeable behind proxies. Privileged roles documented: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE, REDEEM_OPERATOR_ROLE, SETTLEMENT_MANAGER_ROLE, EMERGENCY_ROLE, REDEMPTION_SERVICER_ROLE, REWARD_MANAGER_ROLE, RESTRICTION_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, BRIDGE_ROLE, MARKET_ROLE. No deployed addresses appear in the audit scope section. V1 audits (Plainshift Jan 2026 commit 98849c5; Zellic Aug 2025 commit 845d765) noted; V1 contracts include AxisUSD, AxisUSDMinting, StakedAxisUSD, StakedAxisUSDV2, AxisUSDSilo, StakingRewardsDistributor, AxisUSDRateProvider — all legacy/deprecated per docs.

D4: GitHub repo at https://github.com/Axis-Coordinate/contracts identified from audit report (commit 6db59ec). Direct fetch of the repo root failed (inaccessible/404). No broadcast/run-latest.json, hardhat-deploy artifacts, or deployment index files could be retrieved. Commit SHA 6db59ec confirmed from audit report metadata.
D5: Protocol.chains is Ethereum only; multi-chain enumeration not required. Single-chain D1–D4 applied.
D6: No factory addresses were discovered this run; cannot enumerate children. USDxMarket and MarketConfig are not described as factories in the audit. D6 not applicable pending address discovery.

D7: Role taxonomy applied to audit-sourced contract types. Five logical contracts identified: USDx (token), USDxMarket (router/market), MarketConfig (admin/config store), StakedUSDx (vault), AxisV2Ids (library). All four deployed contracts are proxies (upgradeable). ProxyAdmin owner described as 'governance-owned ProxyAdmin' assumed to be timelock or multisig per audit trust assumptions — no on-chain verification possible this run.

D8: No addresses discovered with fetched-URL backing this run. All contract-type entries recorded in admin_addresses[] are role-typed placeholders without confirmed addresses; they are omitted per D8 integrity rules. All go to unknowns[].

rationale.verdict: Website and audit page fetched successfully (mixed grading basis). Five V2 contract types confirmed from OpenZeppelin audit scope (USDx, USDxMarket, MarketConfig, StakedUSDx, AxisV2Ids). No deployed addresses recovered: the official contract-addresses docs page was rejected by the fetch allowlist, the GitHub repo was inaccessible, and Etherscan name-tag searches returned only unrelated protocols. Zero addresses qualify for admin_addresses[] under D8 integrity rules. Next run should fetch https://docs.axis.to/reference/contract-addresses (now discoverable from this fetch chain) and retry https://github.com/Axis-Coordinate/contracts.

No contract addresses published on homepage.

In-scope: USDx, USDxMarket, MarketConfig, StakedUSDx, AxisV2Ids. All four deployed contracts are upgradeable behind proxies. 25 findings (0 critical, 2 high, 7 medium, 13 low, 3 notes); 24 resolved, 1 partially resolved. Privileged roles enumerated: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE, REDEEM_OPERATOR_ROLE, SETTLEMENT_MANAGER_ROLE, EMERGENCY_ROLE, REDEMPTION_SERVICER_ROLE, REWARD_MANAGER_ROLE, RESTRICTION_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, BRIDGE_ROLE, MARKET_ROLE. protocol_metadata.about: Axis (by Coordinate Labs Pte. Ltd.) is a basis-trading / delta-neutral arbitrage protocol that tokenizes institutional-grade yield into USDx, an ERC-20 synthetic dollar. Users deposit USDT, USDC, or USDx into the Origin Vault to receive sUSDx (StakedUSDx), an ERC-4626/ERC-7540 staking vault that earns linearly vesting rewards from protocol arbitrage profits. Minting and redemption of USDx run through USDxMarket using operator-relayed EIP-712 signed orders with off-chain pricing, while collateral flows to off-chain custodians (Fireblocks, Fordefi) via off-exchange settlement rails (Copper ClearLoop, Ceffu). All four core V2 contracts (USDx, USDxMarket, MarketConfig, StakedUSDx) are upgradeable behind proxies with role-based access control.
